item.title: I’m 63 and spending $95,000 on a roof deck for my $500,000 home. Is that a good investment?
item.dc:creator: World Stock News Editorial Desk
item.description: “I have a net worth of $2.3 million and my only debt is a 15-year mortgage.”

item.title: I inherited $1.4 million from my father. Am I wrong to ask my husband of 25 years for a postnuptial agreement?
item.dc:creator: World Stock News Editorial Desk
item.description: “He has always said he wants his daughter to inherit a chunk of his estate, and I’ve never objected to that.”

item.title: ‘He calls my plans a fantasy’: My husband says we can’t afford a $200,000-a-year retirement. Is he being cheap?
item.dc:creator: World Stock News Editorial Desk
item.description: “We have $2 million saved in our retirement accounts and a house worth $1.3 million.”

item.title: ‘I’m sick of flying’: I paid for priority boarding, but the overhead bins were full. Was I duped?
item.dc:creator: World Stock News Editorial Desk
item.description: “Maybe next time I’ll try the other approach: I’ll board whenever I feel like it and drop my suitcase in the first open slot I see.”

item.title: ‘It leaves me with a sour taste’: My elderly mother gave our cousin $800 for a car repair. Should I be worried?
item.dc:creator: World Stock News Editorial Desk
item.description: “I know older people can easily feel patronized, and I don’t want that to happen.”

item.title: My older brother, who has no children, cut our only sister out of his will. I’ll get everything. Do I tell her?
item.dc:creator: World Stock News Editorial Desk
item.description: “I’m torn between respecting my brother’s wishes and being fair to my sister.”
